name: @baton/agent
//: No database client here, by design. The AgentCore container holds no database credentials, and the root ESLint config fails on any import of pg, postgres, drizzle-orm or @baton/core/db.
//zod: Zod 4 here, Zod 3 in packages/core, deliberately. @strands-agents/sdk peer-depends on zod ^4.1.12 and calls Zod 4 APIs (z.toJSONSchema) while its own barrel initialises, so importing the SDK at all requires v4 — this is a runtime failure, not a typing one. Core stays on v3 because its schemas are shared with Drizzle and the web app. The two never meet: this workspace imports no Zod at all (see src/model/structured.ts SchemaValidator), and core's schema objects only ever have safeParse called on them, which is instance-local.
